occurred_at.$comment: Grammar: pattern enforces normalized UTC/offset seconds form and year 0001-9999 (year 0000 excluded). JSON Schema cannot prove full calendar correctness (e.g. 2026-02-30). Public Python/TS parsers enforce calendar-valid timestamps and unpaired-surrogate rejection; treat schema acceptance of invalid calendar dates outside the pattern as a known limitation, not parity.
